# Needs, protection, and recovery

[Wiki home](../PLAYER_WIKI.md) · [Items](items.md)

## Toilets and other care facilities

Stand beside a toilet or outhouse and press **E**. A cursed diaper can block toilet use.

| Location | Useful facilities |
| --- | --- |
| Honeydew Village | Outhouses around town and a toilet inside the Honeydew Inn. |
| Arcadia | Pay toilets, normally **5 LiDollCoins** per use. |

## Levels, stats & learning

Winning battles earns experience. Each level grants one RPP.

## Cursed equipment

The **Cursebreaker** in each Market Hall removes one cursed item for 20 coins.
